exemplo.dica: Example data: not real yet. It stays like this until the integration is connected or the data is confirmed.
demo.faixa: Demo mode: everything here is an example.
papel.cancha.explica: Agency team: builds rotations, adds ads and events, sees everything, including internal notes.
papel.aprovador.explica: Approves ads or asks for changes, comments and sees the numbers. Does not see Cancha's internal notes or drafts.
papel.leitor.explica: Someone at Spraytec USA who follows everything but does not approve or comment.
papel.produtora.explica: Only receives approved video scripts (next stage of the portal). Does not see budget, numbers or contacts.
login.esqueci_enviado: If this email is registered, a link to create a new password will arrive shortly.
login.demo_explica: Pick who you want to be to see the portal the way that person sees it.
email.rodape: Spraytec USA Marketing Portal · Cancha Marketing
email.aviso_motivo: You got this email because you are part of the Spraytec USA Marketing Portal.
email.convite.assunto: Your access to the Spraytec USA Marketing Portal
email.convite.p1: You've been invited to the Spraytec USA Marketing Portal, where you'll find ad rotations, approvals, the crop-year calendar and results.
email.convite.p2: To get started, create your password.
email.convite.aviso: The link is valid for 7 days and works only once. After that, just sign in with your email and the password you created.
email.redefinir.assunto: New password for the Spraytec USA Portal
email.redefinir.p1: We received a request to create a new password for the Spraytec USA Marketing Portal.
email.redefinir.aviso: The link is valid for 1 hour and works only once. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email: your current password still works.
aviso.aprovar.texto: Cancha sent {n} ad(s) for the next rotation. To go live on time, please approve or ask for changes by {prazo}.
aviso.ajuste.texto: {quem} asked for a change on this ad:
aviso.rotacao_aprovada.texto: {quem} approved all new ads. The rotation can go live.
aviso.no_ar.texto: The {n} ad(s) in this rotation have been live since {data}.
erro.sem_conexao: Can't reach the portal. Check your internet connection and try again.
erro.generico: Something went wrong. Please try again.
erro.tela: This screen couldn't be shown. Please refresh the page.
erro.entrar_de_novo: Please sign in again to continue.
erro.nao_encontrado: Not found. Please refresh the page.
erro.link: {campo}: paste a full link starting with https://
erro.escolha: Please pick a valid option for: {campo}.
erro.datas_ordem: The end date is before the start date.
erro.rotacao_nao_remove: You can only delete a rotation that is still being built and was never sent to Spraytec.
erro.rotacao_travada: This rotation is already live or closed: ads can no longer be changed.
erro.rotacao_falta_aprovar: Some ads are not approved yet (or there are no ads). All of them must be approved before going live.
erro.rotacao_nao_no_ar: Only a live rotation can be closed.
erro.anuncio_travado: This ad can't be changed right now.
erro.anuncio_em_aprovacao: This ad is waiting for approval. Wait for the answer before removing it.
erro.anuncio_sem_peca: “{titulo}” has no creative yet: upload the file, paste the Drive link or write the ad text.
erro.nada_para_enviar: There are no new ads to send.
erro.nada_para_aprovar: There are no ads waiting for approval.
erro.nao_em_aprovacao: This ad is no longer waiting for approval. Please refresh the page.
erro.versao_mudou: Cancha sent a new version of this ad. Refresh the page to see the current version.
erro.resultado_cedo: Numbers can only be added after the ad goes live.
erro.envio_sumiu: Upload not found. Please send the file again.
erro.drive_desconectado: Google Drive is not connected to the portal yet.
erro.arquivo_grande: “{nome}” is larger than 5 GB. Please compress it first.
erro.arquivo_nao_registrado: The file reached Google Drive but was not registered: {motivo}
erro.link_drive: Paste the link to a Google Drive file (drive.google.com/file/d/…).
erro.muitas_tentativas: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
erro.conta_bloqueada: Account locked for a few minutes after several attempts. Try again later or use “Forgot my password”.
erro.link_vencido: This link was already used or has expired. Please ask for a new one.
erro.senha_curta: The password must have at least 8 characters.
erro.sem_email_senha: Email sending is not set up yet. Ask Cancha for a link to create a new password.
erro.sem_email_convite: Email sending is not set up yet. Use “Copy link”.
erro.email_falhou: Couldn't send the email right now. Try again or use “Copy link”.
erro.email_repetido: Someone with this email already exists.
erro.proprio_acesso: You can't remove your own Cancha access.
passo.montar.dica: Cancha picks what stays, what goes and what's new
passo.aprovar.dica: Spraytec approves or asks for changes
passo.resultado.dica: We see what worked and what got tired
objetivo.contatos.explica: The ad leads people to leave their name and phone or email. Media jargon: “conversions” or “leads”.
objetivo.lembrar: Remind people who visited the website
objetivo.lembrar.explica: Shown to people who already visited the site or saw our ads, to bring them back. Jargon: “remarketing”.
objetivo.marca.explica: Reach many people who don't know Spraytec yet, without asking for anything right now. Jargon: “awareness” or “reach”.
objetivo.protecao.explica: Makes sure Spraytec is the first result when someone searches for the brand or a product. Jargon: “brand protection”.
objetivo.concorrentes: Show up when people search competitors
objetivo.concorrentes.explica: Shows Spraytec to people searching for competing brands, without naming them in the ad.
rot.explica: Every two weeks we swap some ads so people don't get tired of them. Each rotation shows what stays, what goes and what's new, and who approved each one.
rot.explica_curta: See what stays, what goes and what's new in these two weeks.
rot.demo_aviso: The rotations in this demo use real Spraytec USA ads, but dates and numbers are examples.
rot.frase.montando.cancha: Build the rotation: decide what stays, add the new ads and send them to Spraytec for approval by {prazo}.
rot.frase.montando.cliente: Cancha is building this rotation. The new ads will come to you for approval before {prazo}.
rot.frase.aprovacao.cancha: Waiting for Spraytec: {n} ad(s) to approve by {prazo}.
rot.frase.aprovacao.cliente: Your turn: {n} ad(s) waiting for your approval by {prazo}. Open each one and tap “Approve” or “Ask for changes”.
rot.frase.ajustes.cancha: Spraytec asked for changes on {n} ad(s). Revise them and send again.
rot.frase.ajustes.cliente: You asked for changes on {n} ad(s). Cancha is revising them and will send them back for your approval.
rot.frase.aprovada.cancha: Everything approved. Upload the ads to the platforms and mark the rotation as live.
rot.frase.aprovada.cliente: Everything approved. Cancha will put the ads live starting {ini}.
rot.frase.no_ar.cancha: Rotation live. At the end of the period, rate each ad (doing well, watch or tired) and close it.
rot.frase.no_ar.cliente: These ads are live now. If you have any comments about them or about the contacts that came in, write them below.
rot.frase.encerrada.cancha: Rotation closed. Each ad's rating helps build the next one.
rot.frase.encerrada.cliente: Rotation closed. See below how each ad did.
rot.enviar_confirma: Send {n} ad(s) to Spraytec for approval? The approval deadline is {prazo}. Spraytec gets an email.
rot.no_ar_explica: Confirm the approved ads are already running on Meta and Google. Spraytec gets a notice.
rot.enc.dica: For each ad, say how it did. If it isn't “doing well”, explain why in one simple sentence: it helps build the next rotation.
rot.enc.motivo: Why? (e.g. cost per contact went up 40%)
rot.enc.falta_motivo: Explain the reason for ads rated “watch” or “tired”.
rot.aprovar_todos_confirma: Approve all {n} ad(s) waiting for approval at once? It will be recorded that you approved each one.
rot.prazo.ajuda: Last day for Spraytec to approve, so there's time to upload the ads before the rotation starts. By default, 3 business days before (US holidays excluded).
rot.prazo.vazio: Leave empty to use 3 business days before the start.
rot.foco.exemplo: E.g. early order for the 2027 season; Iowa Ag Expo in February.
rot.continuam.dica: Doing well and staying live. Already approved before.
rot.saem.dica: Taken down in this rotation, with the reason.
rot.entram.dica: New ads. They need Spraytec's approval.
rot.remover_confirma: Delete this rotation and its drafts? It hasn't been sent to Spraytec yet.
rot.dec.dica: For each one: stays or goes? Ads rated “tired” are already set to “goes”.
rot.dec.motivo: Why is it going? (Spraytec will see this)
rot.dec.nenhum: The previous rotation has no ads to keep.
anuncio.previa_dica: Approximate preview. The final look depends on the platform and the device.
anuncio.peca_no_drive: The creative is on Google Drive (link on the side).
anuncio.publico.ajuda: Who sees the ad: region, age, interests or people who visited the site. Jargon: “audience” or “targeting”.
anuncio.link.ajuda: Page that opens when someone clicks the ad.
anuncio.drive.dica: Optional when the file is uploaded through the portal.
anuncio.nota.dica: Spraytec does not see this note.
anuncio.editar_aprovado: This ad is already approved. If you change anything, it will need approval again (the previous approval stays in the log).
anuncio.enviar_confirma: Send this ad to Spraytec for approval by {prazo}?
anuncio.tirar_confirma: Remove this ad from the rotation? It will be recorded in the log.
anuncio.tirar_continua: This ad came from the previous rotation. It will move to the “Going” column. Please explain why:
anuncio.nome.exemplo: E.g. Tractus Carbon: fall soil health (Search)
anuncio.publico.exemplo: E.g. corn and soybean growers in Iowa and Illinois, 25 to 65.
anuncio.textos.dica: In English, as the audience will see it.
ap.explica: Check the preview and the details. Approve if it looks good, or ask for changes and say what to change. Deadline: {prazo}.
ap.posicao: Ad {i} of {n} to approve in this rotation.
ap.ajuste_dica: Say in your own words what needs to change. Cancha will revise it and send it again.
ap.ajuste_cancha: Revise the ad and send it for approval again.
ap.ajuste_cliente: Cancha will revise it and send it back to you.
ap.ajustando: Cancha is revising this ad. The new version will come to you for approval.
ap.rascunho: Draft: Spraytec can't see this ad yet.
res.manual.dica: Numbers copied by hand from the platforms while the integration isn't connected.
res.integracao_dica: Once Meta and Google Ads are connected, these numbers will come in automatically.
res.digitar_dica: Copy the totals for the rotation period from Ads Manager or Google Ads.
res.investimento.ajuda: How much was spent on this ad in the period, in dollars.
res.impressoes.ajuda: How many times the ad appeared on someone's screen (the same person may count more than once). Jargon: “impressions”.
res.cliques.ajuda: How many times someone clicked the ad.
res.ctr.ajuda: Out of every 100 times it was shown, how many became a click. Higher = the ad gets more attention. Jargon: “CTR”.
res.contatos.ajuda: People who left their name and phone or email. Jargon: “leads”.
res.cpl.ajuda: Spend divided by the number of contacts. Lower = better. Jargon: “CPL”.
arq.sem_drive: To upload files through the portal, Google Drive must be connected. Meanwhile, paste the Drive link in the ad.
arq.tirar_confirma: Remove this file from the ad? It stays in Google Drive.
coment.placeholder: Write in your language. The other person reads it in theirs.
hist.alterado_apos_aprovacao: Changed after approval: needs approval again
inicio.subir: Rotation {periodo} approved: upload the ads and mark it live
inicio.encerrar: Rotation {periodo} ends soon: rate and close it
inicio.sem_eventos: No events in the coming months.
inicio.produtora: Soon, video scripts approved by Spraytec USA will show up here for you. Meanwhile, you can get to know the products.

safra.exemplo_aviso: This calendar is an example built by Cancha from research (official 2027 trade show dates and the Iowa crop cycle). We still need to confirm which shows Spraytec attends.
safra.exemplo_dica: Example: to be confirmed with Spraytec USA.
safra.toque: Tap a bar for details. The red line is today.
safra.marcar_exemplo: Still an example (to be confirmed with Spraytec USA)
safra.remover_confirma: Remove this event from the calendar?
produtos.explica: The {n} Fulltec products, with rate and timing. Use them to tag ads and events.
produtos.fonte: Source: spraytecusa.com and the 2025-26 Product Guide. Always read and follow label instructions.
pessoas.explica: Who can sign in. Each person has their own login, which lets us record who approved what.
pessoas.copiar_explica: Send this link to {nome} another way. It works only once.
pessoas.pode_entrar: Can sign in to the portal
pessoas.sem_email: Email sending isn't set up yet: invites create a link for you to copy.
historico.explica: Record of everything done in the portal. Nobody can delete or change this record.
conta.idioma_explica: Changes the screens, dates, numbers and portal emails. Comments from other people show up translated into your language.
embreve.resultados: Spend, contacts and cost per contact from Meta and Google, by campaign and by ad, with real data once the integrations are connected.
embreve.feedbacks: Spraytec's feedback on ads, campaigns and contacts (good, bad, became a sale), with Cancha's answer and status.
embreve.planejamento: Notes for next month and the approved plan that comes out of them.
embreve.roteiros: Video scripts: idea, script, Spraytec approval, video producer, final video.
embreve.emails: Brevo emails: preview, approval, pre-send checklist and results.
embreve.site: Landing pages and website change requests, with a publishing checklist.
embreve.seo: Google keywords and rankings, organic traffic and presence in AI answers.
